name: Prompt Pratfall
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
You play a prank on a larger creature as you pass by, causing it to topple over. You Stride or Fly (if you have a fly Speed). Once at any point during this movement, you can trip a creature up to three sizes larger than you (or four, if you're legendary in Performance), and you can use your Performance modifier (trip skill=performance) rather than your Athletics modifier on your skill check to do so.
